title: Law to require staff at gyms and self-checkout stores
summary: This bill would require health clubs such as gyms and spas to have at least one employee on site during all business hours. Large non-food retail stores with self-service checkout would need at least one employee supervising the checkout area, and stores with four or more kiosks would need one employee per three kiosks. Violations would bring civil penalties starting at $100, rising to $500 for repeat offenses, and the law would take effect 180 days after enactment.
